description: Validate storage and checkpoint active interviews before context compaction.

hooks.command: PYTHONPATH="$PLUGIN_ROOT/src" uv run --no-editable --project "$PLUGIN_ROOT" python -m interview_growth.hook_cli healthcheck
PYTHONPATH="$PLUGIN_ROOT/src" uv run --no-editable --project "$PLUGIN_ROOT" python -m interview_growth.hook_cli checkpoint
